title: Cataract surgery, one eye
blurb: Day surgery. On the list since April, offered a date in January.
statement: My doctor recommended a cataract operation on my right eye. I have been waiting since April and I cannot afford a large upfront payment.

title: Hip replacement
blurb: Inpatient surgery. Sixteen months on the list and a five-figure bill abroad.
statement: My doctor recommended a hip replacement. I have been on the waiting list since February and I cannot pay thousands of euros up front.

title: Inguinal hernia repair
operation: Unilateral inguinal hernia repair, day case
blurb: Day surgery. A cheap clinic abroad, but the money is needed first.
statement: My surgeon says I need an operation for an inguinal hernia. I have been waiting since March and I cannot pay the clinic first and wait months for a refund.

title: Lumbar spinal fusion
blurb: Major inpatient surgery. The gap left after reimbursement is the story.
statement: My doctor has recommended a spinal fusion in my lower back. I have been waiting more than a year and I cannot put up a large sum of money in advance.
